
## CyMylar 60 Balloon

- Purchased from Amazon <https://a.co/d/08hagKZR>. 
  - Each package contained 2 balloons. 
  
- Each balloon weighed 71 grams as measured.
- After stretching, measured dimensions were:
  - 144 cm half circumference around
  - 146 cm half circumference vertically

### Volume calculation

```{python}
#| label: compute-balloon-dimensions
from numpy import pi

mass = 71.0 # grams

# measurements are half circumference, factor of
# 2 converts to circumference
c1 = 144.0 * 2.0 # cm
c2 = 146.0 * 2.0 # cm

# compute semi-axis radii
a = c1/pi/2 # semi-axis radius cm
b = c1/pi/2 # semi-axis radius cm
c = c2/pi/2 # semi-axis radius cm

# compute volume
volume = 4/3 * pi * a * b * c # cm^3
volume /= 100**3 # m^3
```

```{python}
#| label: print-balloon-dimensions
print_row('Mass',mass,unit='grams',label_width=30)
print_row('Half-cicumference longitudinal',c1,unit='cm',label_width=30)
print_row('Half-cicumference vertical',c2,unit='cm',label_width=30)
print_row('Volume',volume,unit='m**3',label_width=30)
```

Mass                                     71.00 grams
Half-cicumference longitudinal          288.00 cm
Half-cicumference vertical              292.00 cm
Volume                                    0.41 m**3
